position_rmse_paired: Dot-and-interval chart of the paired change in position error, fused against range-only, with a 95% interval for each of 16 scenarios of a synthetic world (development seeds 0-24).
scoreboard: Bar chart tallying, across the scenarios of a synthetic world, whether adding a camera helped. Fused against range-only: precision worse in 14, better in 0 and unclear in 1 scenarios. Bias-estimated against fused: precision worse in 1, better in 3 and unclear in 11 scenarios.
bias_recovery: Two bar charts for the sensor_disagreement_within_gate_high scenario of a synthetic world: track-sample purity and MOTA for range-only, fused and bias-estimated tracking. Bias estimation recovers 45% of the track-sample purity fused tracking lost.
scenario_clip: Animation of one target in the nominal scenario of a synthetic world (seed 1). A range-only track is drawn first, then the fused track is added, both against the dashed ground-truth path.
summary_clip: Animated summary of a simulated, synthetic world, in five beats. One: a moving target is tracked by a range sensor alone. Two: a camera is added and the track looks better. Three: a scoreboard shows the fused tracker is worse than range-only on track-sample purity and MOTA in most scenarios. Four: in the sensor_disagreement_within_gate_high scenario, where the camera has a small bearing bias, estimating the bias recovers part of fusion's loss. Five: an end card reading Synthetic world, full results and limits, with this site's address.
hook_video_poster: Frame from a 44-second explainer video of a synthetic world (dense_clutter, development seeds 0-24): one real object follows a dashed path, and with a camera added the tracker draws many extra ghost lines away from it. Of every 100 tracks reported, 82 were the real object with one sensor and 34 with the camera added.
hero_hurts: Three panels of one simulated target in the dense_clutter scenario of a synthetic world: range sensor only (baseline), camera added: worse here, and bias estimated: no clear change. Ground truth is dashed; each panel marks the 95% position uncertainty at the end of the track. Paired track-sample purity difference, fused against range-only: -0.478, 95% interval [-0.499, -0.457].
hero_recovers: Three panels of one simulated target in the sensor_disagreement_within_gate_high scenario of a synthetic world: range sensor only (baseline), camera added: worse here, and bias corrected: partly recovered. Ground truth is dashed; each panel marks the 95% position uncertainty at the end of the track. Paired track-sample purity difference, bias-estimated against fused: +0.131, 95% interval [+0.100, +0.162].
